seo.title: Cura — Ready for the new EU Air Passenger Rights
seo.description: The EU's landmark air passenger rights reform means airlines must notify passengers electronically within 96 hours of a disrupted arrival and reply to claims within 30 days. Cura's Disruption Rights Outreach automates it — scanning each day's flights and reaching every affected passenger, on time.

title.title: Notify every passenger within 96 hours — automatically
title.body: The EU's landmark reform of air passenger rights changes what airlines must do when a flight is disrupted. Cura's Disruption Rights Outreach turns those new obligations into a workflow that runs itself — so you stay compliant without adding headcount.

facts.title: Proactive 96-hour outreach
facts.body: Airlines will now have to reach out first — notifying every affected passenger within 96 hours. Cura scans each day's flights and sends the outreach automatically, well inside the window, with no one added to the ops team.

facts.title: The real reason, up front
facts.body: Cura reads why each flight was disrupted and tells passengers exactly where they stand — including an immediate heads-up when extraordinary circumstances, like weather or ATC, mean no compensation is due. Fewer dead-end claims, fewer disputes.

facts.title: The right message, every time
facts.body: Every email is matched to the passenger's exact entitlement. And for those caught in the disruption but not owed compensation, Cura can add a goodwill gesture — like 10% off their next flight — turning a bad day into retained loyalty.

section.title: How the outreach runs
section.body: A daily scan fans every disrupted flight into the right rights email — each enriched with the disruption reason.
